summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (MTEK/MTEWW), furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a press release dated August 20, 2026, announcing an additional follow-on order from an existing governmental intelligence-gathering customer. No financial terms, quantities, or delivery dates were disclosed; the order extends deployments previously announced in March, April, and June 2026. CEO Israel Bar and CFO Nir Bussy were quoted and signed. The filing is an ordinary commercial order update, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics apply. Watch order conversion into revenue and customer concentration risk.
